name: Bodyweight Squat
description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your hips while keeping your chest upright, then press through your feet to stand.

name: Wall Push-Up
description: Place your hands against a wall, bend your elbows to move your chest toward it, then push back to the starting position.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Lie on your back with knees bent. Lift your hips until your shoulders, hips, and knees form a straight line, then lower slowly.

name: Standing Knee Raises
description: Stand tall and alternately raise each knee toward your chest at a controlled pace while keeping your core engaged.

name: Forearm Plank
description: Support your body on your forearms and toes. Keep a straight line from shoulders to heels and hold while breathing normally.

name: Reverse Lunge
description: Step one foot backward and lower both knees. Push through the front foot to return, then alternate sides.

name: Bird Dog
description: From hands and knees, extend one arm and the opposite leg. Pause, return with control, and switch sides.

name: Calf Raise
description: Stand upright, rise onto the balls of your feet, pause briefly, and lower your heels with control.

name: Arm Circles
description: Extend both arms to the sides and make controlled circles. Reverse direction after several repetitions.

name: Step Jack
description: Step one foot sideways while raising both arms overhead. Return to the center and repeat on the other side.
